prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity landscape desktop website first-viewport comp for a public developer portfolio homepage
Primary request: Create exactly one polished 1536×1024 desktop homepage composition for the confirmed visual identity “ANALYST’S WORKING PAPER,” variation “ACTIVITY LEDGER.” The visual lineage is an engineering lab book fused with a market activity ledger. It must unmistakably look like a usable responsive public portfolio website, not a poster, slide, magazine cover, or atmosphere image.

Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed straight-on desktop webpage canvas, no browser chrome, no device mockup, no perspective distortion. Pale paper background #F4F7F5.

Subject: Marc Mansour, a developer focused on financial tools who builds and writes about technology, development, and finance. The page treats public making as a continuous record. A slim top header uses workbook index tabs. The hero is split asymmetrically: a strong serif thesis and two actions occupy the left half; the right half shows a restrained annotated schematic of an unnamed financial app project, like a lead case-file clipped into the ledger. Across the middle of the entire viewport runs a clearly structured horizontal band labeled “Recent public activity” with handle “marcm8793”: a GitHub-like 13-week activity matrix of tiny square cells, only a few lime active cells because the public API presently exposes modest recent activity, plus three small factual event ledger rows labeled “ISSUE”, “FORK”, “ISSUE” and repository “callstackincubator/voltra”. Do not show a contribution total. A red editorial circle and blue arrow connect activity evidence to the app dossier. Begin the next fold with three index entries: Projects, About, and Blog, arranged like a research binder contents page.

Style/medium: High-fidelity editorial web UI, rigorous information design, analyst notebook meets software portfolio, warm human annotations over precise grid systems. Flat front-on interface design. Refined typography, strong hierarchy, generous negative space, production-realistic interaction affordances, crisp 1px rules. Avoid generic fintech aesthetics.

Composition/framing: 1536×1024 landscape. Compact top header. Navigation items look like workbook index tabs. In the top 55% of the viewport, the left thesis is the typographic anchor while the right app dossier is the visual proof. The activity ledger is a full-width horizontal ribbon that crosses the lower edge of both, giving the composition its unmistakable move. The lead finance project dossier slightly overlaps the ledger edge. Reveal about 18% of the next contents section at the bottom. Keep all content safely within canvas.

Lighting/mood: Bright diffuse paper-like daylight, cerebral, credible, exploratory, precise, not glossy.

Color palette: paper #F4F7F5, ink #101828, cobalt #174EA6, data lime #B6F23A, signal red #D93D45. Cobalt rules and annotations; lime used sparingly for activity/data marks; red only for proof marks.

Materials/textures: subtle recycled paper grain, blue ledger ruling, carbon annotations, translucent chart overlays, index tabs, registry stamps, case-file overlays, registration marks; retain clean modern web UI legibility.

Text (verbatim, render every item exactly and legibly):

Navigation: “HOME”, “PROJECTS”, “ABOUT”, “RESUME”, “CONTACT”, “BLOG”
Eyebrow: “FINANCE × SOFTWARE”

Product label: “LEAD CASE / FINANCIAL APP”
GitHub label: “Recent public activity”
GitHub handle: “marcm8793”
Event labels: “ISSUE”, “FORK”, “ISSUE”
Repository label: “callstackincubator/voltra”

Constraints: Exact visible copy only as specified above; nav must clearly read as navigation; both actions must clearly read as actionable controls; show clear webpage structure and usable alignment; the financial app figure must remain unnamed and schematic; no profile portrait; no logos; no stock photography; no readable invented numbers, metrics, company names beyond the supplied public GitHub repository label, clients, testimonials, awards, employers, or claims. Avoid: generic fintech dashboard, bento grid, centered hero, polished corporate deck, glowing gradients, dark crypto UI, banking app cliché, fake analytics, dense all-green activity field, invented contribution totals, invented metrics, dates, company names, clients, testimonials, app names, employers, awards, fake article titles, fake body copy, poster composition, browser chrome, watermark, illegible or misspelled required text.
